name: Instagram Product Post
prompt:
**Task:** Create an Instagram-native product showcase post

**Style:**
- Vibrant, thumb-stopping design
- Gradient background (purple to blue)
- Modern rounded typography
- 3D-style floating UI mockups

**Output:**
- Square format (1080x1080px)
- Rich gradient with subtle texture

**Content:**
- Headline: "Ship Faster With Smart Roadmaps"
- Visual: 3D perspective mockups of roadmap interface
- Branding: Small logo bottom corner
- Emoji: Rocket ship 🚀

**Layout:**
- Centered composition
- Headline at top with padding
- Mockups arranged in perspective stack
- Balanced negative space

**Constraints:**
- English text only
- High contrast for mobile viewing
- Instagram-optimized colors
exampleUse: Instagram posts, product showcases, feature highlights on social media

name: LinkedIn Professional Graphic
prompt:
**Task:** Create a professional LinkedIn insight post

**Style:**
- Clean, corporate aesthetic
- Professional color scheme (navy, white, gold accent)
- Serif and sans-serif combination
- Data visualization elements

**Output:**
- Landscape format (1200x627px, LinkedIn native)
- Solid or subtle gradient background

**Content:**
- Headline: "The State of Product Management 2025"
- Supporting stat: "73% of PMs say AI changed their workflow"
- Visual: Simple bar chart or infographic element
- Branding: Company name "ProductFlow Insights"

**Layout:**
- Text-heavy design, left-aligned
- Chart/visual element right side
- Professional spacing and hierarchy
- Subtle brand accent at bottom

**Constraints:**
- English text only
- Corporate professional tone
- Optimized for LinkedIn feed
exampleUse: LinkedIn posts, industry insights, thought leadership content, B2B marketing

name: Twitter/X Announcement Card
prompt:
**Task:** Create a Twitter/X card for feature announcement

**Style:**
- Bold, punchy design
- High-contrast colors (black background, electric blue accents)
- Condensed bold typography
- Minimal graphic elements

**Output:**
- Twitter card format (1200x675px)
- Dark background with neon accents

**Content:**
- Headline: "NEW: Real-Time Sync"
- Subtext: "Your team, always in sync. Zero lag."
- Icon: Sync symbol with glow effect
- Branding: "TaskFlow" wordmark

**Layout:**
- Centered text
- Large icon top center
- Headline middle
- Brand bottom
- Plenty of breathing room

**Constraints:**
- English text only
- High contrast for timeline scanning
- Eye-catching but not cluttered
exampleUse: Twitter/X announcements, quick feature drops, social media launch teasers

name: Product Launch Gradient
prompt:
**Task:** Create an exciting product launch announcement

**Style:**
- Futuristic gradient design
- Multi-color gradient (cyan to purple to pink)
- Bold geometric typography
- Light rays and glow effects

**Output:**
- Landscape format (1920x1080px)
- Dynamic flowing gradient background

**Content:**
- Headline: "Introducing PulseFlow 2.0"
- Subheadline: "The future of agile project management"
- Launch date: "Available January 15, 2025"
- Visual: Abstract geometric shapes suggesting movement

**Layout:**
- Text centered with dramatic spacing
- Geometric elements framing the text
- Symmetrical composition
- Glowing accents

**Constraints:**
- English text only
- All text prominently displayed
- Exciting, launch-worthy energy
exampleUse: Major product launches, version releases, big announcements, event promotion

name: Product Flat Lay Photography
prompt:
**Task:** Create an artistic flat lay photograph of productivity tools and stationery.

**Style:**
- Overhead photography with clean, organized arrangement
- Natural light from above creating soft shadows
- Minimalist aesthetic with plenty of negative space
- Professional product photography quality
- Soft focus on edges, crisp center

**Output:**
- Square aspect ratio (1:1)
- Clean white or neutral background

**Content:**
- Tech gadgets (laptop, phone, headphones)
- Notebooks, pens, coffee cup
- Geometric arrangement with intentional spacing
- Conveys productivity and organization

**Layout:**
- Perfectly overhead view (bird's eye)
- Objects arranged in pleasing grid or diagonal
- Balanced composition with breathing room

**Constraints:**
- No text or logos
- Clean, professional aesthetic
- Realistic photography
- Subtle shadows only
exampleUse: Product showcases, tool collections, organizational systems, professional aesthetics
